defs.def: a thing that is made to be the same as sth else, especially a document or a work of art （尤指文件或艺术品的）复印件，副本，复制品

ex.s: One of the four original copies of the Magna Carta is displayed there.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯是五列政府资助的医疗列车之一，行驶至俄罗斯中部和东部的偏远城镇。

ex.s: Where can you find an original copy of the Magna Carta?
ex.t: 你在哪里能找到《大宪章》的原始副本？

ex.s: It was a brand new copy.
If your card has been reported to the Police as stolen, please also call into the SAC to request a replacement, bringing with you a copy of your Police Crime Report paperwork.
ex.t: 如果你的卡已被报警称被盗，请也到SAC申请补发，并带上一份警方报案文件的复印件。

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 馆际互借（ILL）为教师、学生和工作人员提供借阅已借出或本馆未收藏的图书的渠道，以及本馆收藏的文章和书籍章节的数字副本。

defs.def: a single example of a book, newspaper, etc. of which many have been made （书、报纸等的）一本，一册，一份

ex.s: In addition, I have an old two-volume copy of the Shorter Oxford Dictionary, picked up a few years ago in a bookshop sale for just 99 pence.
ex.t: 此外，我有一套旧的《简明牛津词典》上下两册，是几年前在书店特卖时只花99便士买到的。

ex.s: I was about 13 when an uncle gave me a copy of Jostein Gaarder’s Sophie’s World.
ex.t: 我大约13岁时，一位叔叔送了我一本乔斯坦·贾德写的《苏菲的世界》。

ex.s: If, at a later date, you wish to apply for a job or graduate school where an official copy of your UCLA record is required, it will be to your advantage to provide an impressive academic record.
ex.t: 如果在以后的日子里，你申请的工作或研究生院需要你的加州大学洛杉矶分校成绩单的正式副本，那么提供一份令人印象深刻的学业记录将对你有好处。

ex.s: When it was eventually published, the book became an immediate best-seller and went on to sell millions and millions of copies.
ex.t: 当它最终出版时，这本书立即成为畅销书，并最终售出了数百万册。

ex.s: Even when the book sold only two copies，the sisters still didn't give up.
ex.t: 即使那本书只卖出了两本，姐妹们仍然没有放弃。

defs.def: written material that is to be printed in a newspaper, magazine, etc; news or information that can be used in a newspaper article or advertisement （报刊等的）稿件；（可用于报纸文章或广告的）消息，信息

ex.s: Three days ago, to complete her homework quickly, she copied part of the article without thinking.
ex.t: 三天前，为了快速完成作业，她想都没想就抄了文章的一部分。

defs.def: 请把这一页给我复印十份好吗？
a book used by students for writing exercises, etc. in 作业本；练习本
to make sth that is exactly like sth else 复制；复印；仿造；临摹

ex.s: Make a copy of each piece.
At that time, the most common way to study horse painting was by copying the works of previous painters.
ex.t: 当时，学习画马最常用的方法就是临摹前代画家的作品。

ex.s: I had never cooked anything before, so I fried to copy how she did if.
ex.t: 我以前从未做过饭，所以我试着模仿她的做法。

defs.def: to write sth exactly as it is written somewhere else 抄写；誊写

ex.s: For some terms, they simply copied out the correct definition; for others, they were asked to first add an error in their description of the term before  correcting the mistake.
ex.t: 对于一些术语，他们直接抄写正确的定义；对于另一些，他们被要求在对该术语的描述中加入一个错误，然后再纠正这个错误。

ex.s: Yet the exact opposite was true: the participants who made deliberate errors learned about twice as much as the people who simply copied out the correct definitions.
ex.t: 然而事实恰恰相反：那些故意犯错的参与者学到的东西大约是单纯抄写正确定义的人的两倍。

defs.def: to behave or do sth in the same way as sb else 模仿；效法；仿效

ex.s: Do we want to copy — or even worsen — the traffic of today with driverless cars?
ex.t: 我们是要用无人驾驶汽车去模仿——甚至加剧——当今的交通状况吗？

defs.def: to cheat in an exam, school work, etc. by writing what sb else has written and pretending it is your own work 作弊；抄袭
